By morning, the shore was empty except for fresh footprints leading toward his door, and a second photograph showing him holding the lamp, taken from somewhere out on the dark water.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一本尚未合上的书。路灯照着空荡的街道，雨水沿屋檐缓缓滴落。早餐铺亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽托着面香飘过巷口。清洁工推车经过，车轮轻响，惊醒树上的鸟。远处，一辆夜班公交驶向桥头。有人刚结束工作，有人正准备出发，而天边的灰蓝色，已悄悄变得温柔。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using the same method on a smaller version of it.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then opening that one the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you find a box with no box inside."}
